ablation_findings.summary: YOLO26s baseline (640px, 20ep, partial 2,179 train imgs): Val Acc = 27.9160/100 (mAP@50=0.3159, mAP@50:95=0.1248, P=0.3559, R=0.3862), T4 latency = 15.92ms (Speed=1.00), Synth Stress mAP@50 = 0.1030, Kaggle Public LB = 26.82890 (sub #58774828).

Deep Error Analysis on v2 (n=2,150 val, 109,296 raw boxes): TIDE Oracle Loc (+9.91 pts) & Bkg (+6.99 pts) dominate; 720x720 India domain collapses 2x vs 600x600 (0.1831 vs 0.3606); dark_luma DRI collapses -98.63% (0.0137); Clean-vs-Defect ROC-AUC=0.9015; D-ECE=0.0746 (underconfident); Eigen-CAM reveals sky/windshield attention waste.
Negative result: 5-fold OOF post-processing threshold/sky/clean gates dropped Clean Val from 27.9161 to 27.2620 (-0.6542 pts; 5/5 folds chose sky_cut=0.0, clean_gate=0.0).

YOLO26m full train (768px, 14,691 imgs, 50 ep in 5.696h on L4, 70/30 OneOf aug): best.pt (Ep 38) ultralytics val mAP@50=0.549, mAP@50:95=0.253, P=0.594, R=0.518 (D00=0.486, D10=0.481, D20=0.690, D40=0.539), L4 latency 12.8ms; weights saved on Drive (1fdbGdrbd89roYgHkpxHJzIMOMXjHKz6n, 44.06 MB) before 4h check_budget() halt.

v3 YOLO26m (768px, 14,691 imgs, Ep 38 best.pt, T4 A_raw): Clean Val Acc = 46.0687/100 (mAP@50=0.5465, mAP@50:95=0.2422, P=0.6106, R=0.5032), Stress mAP@50 = 0.2775 (2.69x vs v2), T4 latency = 21.302ms val / 21.925ms test (Speed=1.00), Final Proxy = 50.5461, Kaggle Public LB = 44.99750 (#1 OVERALL, sub #58788362, +1.4427 vs #2).

3-way T4 inference A/B ablation: C_lut_fliptta_wbf improved Clean Val Acc +1.4844 pts to 47.5532 (mAP@50=0.5688, Stress=0.2844), but doubled T4 latency to 43.641ms (Speed=0.758, -2.42 Composite pts), lowering Final Proxy to 49.4223 vs A_raw 50.5461.

v3 Advanced T4 Error Analysis (689.14s, 0.3750 CUs, Cleanlab 2.9.0, n=2,150 Val): 500x bootstrap CI [44.731, 48.169] with paired gain [15.0578, 18.2246], P(v3>v2)=1.0; Cleanlab mean quality=0.9519 (28/2,150 flagged, drag=-0.3799); IoU@0.75 collapses to 0.1722 (TIDE Loc=+9.88, Bkg=+8.68); 720p India=0.3662 vs 600p=0.5941; dark_luma DRI=0.0484 (-95.16%); Eigen-CAM sky energy=22.75% above y=0.22*H; NMS iou=0.55 gains +0.2399 pts (n=600) & Bright CLAHE +0.0045; Test empty @0.226=51.67% vs Val 45.53%.

hyperparameter_lessons.applied_to_v3: 70% clean / 30% single-degradation OneOf training; TF32 + cuDNN autotune + VRAM/RAM/Disk auto-scaling; vectorized YOLO normalization; <1ms LUT conditional low-light rescue A/B tested on clean + 4-bucket degraded val.
hyperparameter_lessons.finding: 100% 1:1 square RGB images with 0 duplicates/leaks; 42% background-only; D10 has 5.1x W/H thin geometry; cross-class GT overlaps require agnostic_nms=False; 95% of damage lies below y=0.30*H; Test set has distinct dark luma (20-50), severe blur (lap=2), JPEG (bpp=0.04-0.05), and grain tails.

Top-22% sky/windshield crop preserves >95% of damage boxes while removing Eigen-CAM distractor regions and zooming road pixels 1.28x; CLAHE contrast normalization targets Q4 Brightest & 720x720 Indian concrete collapse (0.1831 vs 0.3606).
hyperparameter_lessons.planned_for_v4: Train & infer with Top-22% Sky-Crop + CLAHE on YOLO26l and cross-family D-FINE-M (ustc-community/dfine-medium-coco, pure COCO) + WBF ensemble.

hyperparameter_lessons.finding: close_mosaic=10 caused mild overfitting drift in Epochs 41-50 (mAP@50:95 slipped from Ep 38 peak 0.253 to 0.246-0.247 while best.pt safely retained Ep 38); 50 epochs @768px L4 bs=16 took 5.696h > 4h budget cap.
hyperparameter_lessons.planned_for_v4: Use close_mosaic=4..5 and max_hours>=7.5 on multi-hour 768px YOLO L4 runs; evaluate completed v3 best.pt cleanly via 02b_datasprint_v3_eval_and_submit.ipynb.

hyperparameter_lessons.finding: Flip-TTA + WBF raises Clean Val +1.4844 pts (46.07 -> 47.55) on 1x T4, but 43.64ms median latency drops Speed_T4 from 1.000 to 0.758 (-2.42 Final pts); only sub-25ms fast pipelines or TensorRT WBF improve the official 85/10/5 composite.
hyperparameter_lessons.next_action: Benchmark <=25ms TensorRT / D-FINE-M + YOLO26m WBF before promoting ensemble over A_raw.

hyperparameter_lessons.finding: After v3, dark_luma DRI remains 0.0484 (D00=0.0005, D10=0.0001) and test-time linear gamma degraded -0.0056 (0.0262->0.0206), proving training-time dark augmentation frequency must rise. Eigen-CAM wastes 22.75% activation above y=0.22*H (1.41% GT), and NMS iou=0.55 beats 0.60 by +0.2399 pts.

domain_profile.docs_style_guide: [computer_vision] Resolution & augmentation ablations, mAP/IoU across object sizes/classes, qualitative failure taxonomy, and FPS/latency tradeoff. | [deep_learning] Convergence curves, train-val generalization gap, architecture & regularization ablations, and checkpoint resume verification.
leakage_controls: Group split by video/patient/scene/camera to prevent near-duplicate frame leakage
Apply random augmentations to training split only
Select checkpoint on validation split only
No outside road/pavement/crack data; competition data only
Generic COCO or ImageNet pretrained weights only (never road-damage weights)
Keep low-confidence detections down to 0.001; max 100 detections per image
Synthetic blur/low-light/noise/JPEG degradations applied only to training or local robustness stress-val, never mixed across splits
